notes:
What's new in Vekrun 0.5.4 — The Board, straightened out

• Tickets from Markdown: no more dead end. Your open project is offered right away (Vekrun adds it to the Board when you import), the import comes first and the how-to is tucked away, and importing files that are already on the Board says they're up to date instead of "no tickets found".
• One clear button per tab: New work item on Overview, New ticket on Tickets.
• The Overview queue shows your local and Markdown tickets too (they were hidden by the project filter), without Vekrun's internal ids.
• Ticket cards no longer repeat their id in the title.
